dict.string: Lock In shows where you are on the gym map and notes when you arrive at your gym. Your location stays on your phone.
So Lock In can note when you arrive at and leave your gym, even when the app is closed, and time your workout. Your location stays on your phone.
Lock In uses the camera for your gym check-in and meal photos.
Lock In uses the microphone when you describe a workout or a meal out loud.
Lock In turns what you say into a workout or a meal entry.
